# Copilot instructions for Cranelisp

Read and follow [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) before changing this repository. It
is the canonical repository instruction file for all coding agents: it declares
which roles this repository dispatches, what each owns, and how work is filed
between them.

Role contracts live in the shared package at `.agents/skills/<role>/SKILL.md`,
and `sprints/METHOD.md` carries what cranelisp adds to them.
